title: formation controller
features:
place 64 unconnected blocks then launch for it to work, has mobile support(i couldnt test it on a mobile device but gui should be there)
keybinds:

   P       On / Off
   H       Cube 
   B       Wall 
   L        Ring
   V       Orbit 
   M      Swarm 
   K       Shield
   J       Staircase (infinite)
   C       Storm (spawns where your mouse is pointing)
   N       Explode
   Insert       Destroy script
